1.consolidated_definition: Arbusto de hasta 6 m de altura, de tronco fino con corteza pardo grisácea, agrietada pero persistente, hojas perennes, opuestas, lanceoladas y acuminadas, flores blancas dispuestas de a tres en un pedúnculo axilar y fruto pequeño y redondo. Myrtaceae Myrica cerifera.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Shrub reaching up to 6 m in height, with a slender trunk and greyish-brown bark that is cracked but persistent; perennial leaves are opposite, lanceolate, and acuminate; white flowers are arranged in threes on an axillary peduncle, and the small, round fruit follows. Myrtaceae Myrica cerifera.
